character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Grimdark 16-bit pixel art playable character, a dark hooded Bloodmage sorcerer. Wears tattered deep crimson and blood-red robes with dark charcoal shadows and tarnished gold rune embroidery along the hems. Face is completely obscured in dark shadow beneath the deep hood, with two faint glowing crimson eyes. Holds a curved bone scythe with carved runes in one hand. Dark fantasy, ominous hemomancer, gothic RPG hero, Diablo 1 aesthetic, crisp clean pixels.
